title: BLACKPINK’s LISA Designed Meta Glasses With Charms Inspired by Her Pets & Exclusive Digital Treats
summary: Available now, the collab includes two distinct styles of AI glasses, with surprise features for fans.
contentText:

LISA is ready to see the world through a whole new lens. The BLACKPINK superstar teamed up with Meta to help design her own limited-edition Meta Glasses , bringing her signature style into the world of wearable tech. The collaboration blends fashion, fandom and functionality with details that feel distinctly LISA, including a star motif and surprise charms inspired by her beloved pets, affectionately known as The L Family.

More than a year in the making, the collection features two styles designed to capture different sides of the BLACKPINK star. The Meta Adventurer LISA Edition pairs a Moonlit Sky frame with blush lenses, while the Meta Capri LISA Edition takes a more feline approach with an Eclipse cat-eye frame and gray lenses. Once the glasses are set up, fans can unlock LISA-themed digital experiences through the Meta AI app, including a collectible digital photocard that can be shared to Instagram Stories, a LISA-inspired sticker pack for Meta AI and Instagram and additional surprises to discover in the app.

The Meta Glasses by LISA come with plenty of personality built into the details. Each pair features a custom star detail on the temple tips and comes with an exclusive collectible charm inspired by LISA’s beloved pets. The glasses also include a quilted star charging case designed to be compact enough for easy carrying.

Meta

Beyond the LISA-inspired details, the glasses offer a range of hands-free technology designed for everyday use. A 12MP camera supports POV photos and 3K video capture, while over eight hours of battery life helps keep you connected throughout the day. Open-ear speakers provide immersive audio without blocking out your surroundings and six microphones help keep calls clear.

Users can make hands-free calls, send messages, start video calls through WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger and share their live location with a simple voice command. Live translation can help bridge language gaps while Meta AI can provide local recommendations using current information. The glasses are also prescription-ready with a variety of lens options and adjustable temple tips, three-way adjustable nose pads and overextension hinges for a comfortable fit.

The LISA x Meta collab is the latest product drop from the tech giant this week, with the brand’s first audio-only Meta AI glasses available for pre-order ahead of its Oct. 13 release.

At the same time as her custom Meta Glasses drop, LISA is gearing up for the release of her feature documentary, Always Lalisa , which comes out on Oct. 12. The singer is also promoting the release of her upcoming EP, PRESS PLAY , out Oct. 23. The project will pay homage to the star’s Thai roots and her journey as a K-pop phenomenon. As she told Jimmy Fallon on The Tonight Show on Wednesday, Sept. 16, “This EP is about my journey from my roots to where I am right now today.”
